title: epan: Sort dissector table handles after registration
description:
When initially adding handles to the dissector tables on
registration at program start up, just prepend every handle
to the GSLists, and then sort once after registration is done.
As we're adding thousands of handles to tables, this is fairly
significant.

For future insertions, such as by Lua plugins (including after
reloading Lua plugins) or by UAT or other preferences, continue
to insert sorted.

This keeps #7348 fixed while reducing the number of calls according
to callgrind at startup by 10%.
